testcase.name: Given no stored token when unregisterToken then returns failure()
Given a reachable server returning HTTP 500 when register then a hard failure surfaces()
Given token when registerTokenForAllAccounts then saves token to EncryptedPrefs()
Given no token stored when getStoredToken then returns null()
Given no accounts when registerTokenForAllAccounts then returns success()
Given the per-account POST throws CancellationException when register then it propagates (never swallowed)()
Given no accounts when reconcileToken then short-circuits without registering and returns success()
Given at least one account when reconcileToken then saves and registers the current token()
Given already-current token when reconcileToken runs twice then behavior is stable()
Given reconcileOnAccountAvailable fired twice when redundant then both succeed and re-register (idempotent)()
Given a reachable account when registerTokenForAllAccounts then success and token saved()
Given one live and one unreachable account when register then success and the live account is still POSTed()
Given account not found when registerToken then returns failure()
Given account not found when unregisterToken then returns failure()
Given 2 accounts when registerTokenForAllAccounts then attempts registration for each()
Given token stored when getStoredToken then returns it()
Given a stored token and two accounts when reconcileOnAccountAvailable then a register is POSTed for each account()
Given no token has arrived yet when reconcileOnAccountAvailable then it is a no-op success with no POST()
Given every account is unreachable when register then failure (nothing registered anywhere)()
Given a token arrived before any account when the account later appears then reconcileOnAccountAvailable registers it()
Given the register POST throws CancellationException when reconcileOnAccountAvailable then it propagates()
